text:
Tara: heads-up  a recruiter spotted duplicate scorecard assignments on a small batch of interviews this morning. two interviewers got the same form link.

Emma (People Ops): yikes. sample interview id?

Tara: int_dup_210 sample. recruiter says both panelists see link to "onboard-rubric-v2" but second panelist report should've been "peer-rubric-v1".

Sync Bot: event=interview.assigned id=int_dup_210 status=200 payload=assigned_templates:[onboard-rubric-v2,onboard-rubric-v2]

Leon - Recruiting Ops: that looks like the bulk-importer de-dup step failed. we ran a CSV yesterday to assign templates for a hiring spike. i'll check the upload.

Diego - Eng: there's a known race in the assignment worker when two updates hit the same interview row quickly. it can overwrite the template list with the last write. i pushed a small lock change but maybe the job hit before that deployed. checking job logs.

Diego - Eng: log: "WARN assignment_worker: concurrent_update detected for interview_id=int_dup_210". locking wasn't enabled for that run.

Emma (People Ops): immediate priority: ensure affected interviews have correct, distinct scorecards before the debriefs. Leon, can you export the impacted interviews?

Leon - Recruiting Ops: running query now: ```sql SELECT interview_id, interviewer_ids, templates_assigned FROM interview_assignments WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2024-08-05' AND '2024-08-05 06:00' AND array_length(templates_assigned,1)=2; ``` got 8 rows. uploading CSV to #people-ops-attachments.

Tara: two of those already had debriefs completed :grimacing:. we'll need to flag those for manual correction.

Diego - Eng: ok i'll run a reconcile script that checks the desired template per interviewer role and patches mismatches. will run in staging first and share sample diffs.

Leon - Recruiting Ops: fallback policy for now: if ambiguous, set templates to what the panel lead selected in ATS UI. that preserves intent.

Diego - Eng: staging reconcile done. sample int_dup_210 diff: templates_assigned changed from [onboard-rubric-v2,onboard-rubric-v2] to [onboard-rubric-v2,peer-rubric-v1]. verified email links updated.

Emma (People Ops): please proceed to prod once you post the prod job id here. also please add a short note to the hiring ops runbook about manual checks after bulk imports.

Diego - Eng: prod job job-cc102 started 2024-08-05T10:20Z. patched 8 interviews. 2 had completed debriefs: left as-is and flagged for recruiter follow-up. job finished with no other errors.

Leon - Recruiting Ops: contacting recruiters about the 2 completed debriefs to ask for manual reconciliation notes. adding a quick ticket template to minimize churn.

Tara: thanks. follow-up asks: 1) can eng add a preflight check in the bulk-importer that ensures locking is enabled, 2) can recruiting add a confirmation modal in the UI listing which templates will be assigned per interviewer.

Diego - Eng: will do. opened ticket ENG-6742 for preflight check + add idempotent write guarantee.

Emma (People Ops): i'll update the runbook and draft the recruiter message template. closing loop unless anyone sees more duplicates. :white_check_mark:
